messages:
alex: Onboarding atlas-2.7b-quant to staging. Found weights at s3://redwood-models/atlas/2.7b/quant/v1/; tokenizer seems to lose BOS on some prompts. Anyone seen this before?
jen: I saw a similar edgecase on atlas fork — tokenizer manifest sometimes has "bos_token": null. Can you paste the tokenizer json/config?
alex: Paste: {"tokenizer_type":"bytepair","bos_token":null,"pad_token":"<pad>","vocab_size":50288} — this is from the model bundle in S3.
tim: If bos_token is null the runtime ends up inserting 0 which breaks prefixing and canned prompts. Quick fix: set bos_token to "<s>" in tokenizer.json. Also we should validate Triton model config (pbtxt) for kernel hints.
sam: On kernel selection, this model uses int8-packed GEMM kernels. Our runtime currently picks the "fused_attn_v2" path which requires CUDA>=12.2 + recent cuDNN. If image is cuda11.x it falls back to slow emulation. That could explain CI timeouts.
jen: What CUDA version are we shipping in inference-runtime image for staging? Docker tag/name?
alex: Buildkite shows image inference-runtime:cuda11.8-triton23.09 (ugh). So that explains mismatch with the required kernels. Options: rebuild image with cuda12.2 or force a safe kernel fallback at runtime.
tim: I can do a cuda12.2 image but that bumps node driver requirements. For a quick unblock we can set REDWOOD_GEMM_EMU=1 to force the safe path (slower but stable). Also we should add a model-config hint to prefer "fallback_gemm" for older images.
sam: For staging smoke test I'd prefer env flip. Can someone patch the k8s manifest? I'll also add a CI lint to catch bos_token nulls in model bundles so onboarding fails fast.
alex: Pushed k8s patch to deployment atlas-2.7b-staging: set env REDWOOD_GEMM_EMU=1 and updated S3 tokenizer to s3://redwood-models/atlas/2.7b/quant/v1/tokenizer.json with bos_token set to "<s>".
deploy-bot: deployed atlas-2.7b-staging to cluster/ai-staging (rollout 1/3) :rocket:
jen: :eyes: Running a quick smoke now: POST /v1/generate with short prompt — will report latency + correctness in a few mins.
alex: Smoke passed for correctness but latency is ~2.8x compared to local int8 run. OK for staging. Let's schedule proper image rebuild and CI kernel selection checks. Filing ticket.
sam: Filed INF-1248: "atlas-2.7b-quant: image rebuild + tokenizer manifest lint". Assigning tim for image rebuild and alex for tokenizer/manifest verification. I'll add a preflight CI job to validate tokenizer fields.
tim: Ack. I'll start building inference-runtime:cuda12.2-triton23.11 tomorrow, ETA EOD (need to validate drivers in canary).
jen: Thanks all. Can we also add a lint hook to the model onboarding checklist to reject missing bos_token or pad_token mismatches? Saves future rollbacks.
alex: Done — docs updated: /docs/model-onboarding.md (added tokenizer schema check and kernel compatibility matrix).
